preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The input root must be either None or a valid TreeNode instance.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in [root] if node is not None)
preconditions.description: All nodes in the tree must be valid TreeNode instances.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= node.val <= 10**5 for node in [root] if node is not None)
preconditions.description: Each node's value must be between 0 and 10^5 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(node.nextRight is None for node in [root] if node is None)
postconditions.description: If a node is None, its nextRight pointer must be None.

postconditions.expression: all(node.nextRight is None or isinstance(node.nextRight, TreeNode) for node in [root] if node is not None)
postconditions.description: For each non-None node, nextRight must either be None or point to a valid TreeNode.

postconditions.expression: all(node.nextRight is None or node.nextRight.val == next_node.val for node in [root] if node is not None and (next_node := node.nextRight) is not None)
postconditions.description: For each non-None node, if nextRight is not None, it must point to the next node at the same level.

postconditions.expression: all(node.nextRight is None or node.nextRight.parent == node.parent for node in [root] if node is not None and (next_node := node.nextRight) is not None)
postconditions.description: For each non-None node, if nextRight is not None, it must point to a node at the same level (same parent).

postconditions.expression: all(node.nextRight is None or node.nextRight.left is None or node.nextRight.right is None or (node.left is not None and node.left.nextRight == node.nextRight) or (node.right is not None and node.right.nextRight == node.nextRight) for node in [root] if node is not None and (next_node := node.nextRight) is not None)
postconditions.description: For each non-None node, if nextRight is not None, the nextRight pointer must be consistent with the children's nextRight pointers at the next level.
